versions.changelog:
- Initial release of apipay, enabling prepaid web search, URL fetch, and weather queries without vendor keys.
- Provides three key “no-key” services: Google web search, markdown URL fetch, and Open-Meteo weather, all accessed via credits.
- Signup grants users a bearer token and 500 free credits; no user keys required for main APIs.
- Additional APIs (Brave, ScrapingBee, OpenWeather) available via user key if desired.
- Standardized API tools: search_apis, call_api, check_balance, and get_vault_link.
- Clear guidance on handling 402 errors (payment required) and catalog misses—do not ask for vendor keys unnecessarily.
